description: List a Monitor's Cycles, newest first — one row per Cycle with its status, timestamps, the engine id it ran from, and headline response times; a Cycle with no status yet is scheduled or still running. Window with since/until and limit to spot patterns — flapping around a threshold, slow drift, failures from one region — then drill into one Cycle's full metrics and failure message with get_monitor_cycle_detail. The 'monitoring' topic explains what each status means.

limit.description: How many Cycles to return (default 20, maximum 100).

since.description: Only Cycles scheduled at or after this ISO-8601 instant (2026-08-26T00:00:00Z) or date (2026-08-26).

until.description: Only Cycles scheduled before this ISO-8601 instant or date (exclusive).

name: list_monitor_cycles
title: List Monitor Cycles
